limits: A valid receipt says each party’s key signed its own part and the parts chain. It does not say any party told the truth.

The carried keys are the parties’ only if the verifier already holds those key_ids from somewhere else. A receipt cannot vouch for its own keys. When two roles are signed by one key, one holder signed both.
The acceptance names who accepted. The signature proves the acceptor’s key signed the receipt, not that the person named did.
money none means no money is held or paid by this receipt.
limits is not covered by the signature: someone who removes it leaves a receipt that still verifies.
The checks prove only what they test. A passed record says the pinned commands exited 0 on that tree, not that the work is good.
A test that cannot fail is not detected by this record.

The checker ran them as recorded only as far as the verifier trusts the checker’s key. The signature proves the holder of the carried key issued the record, and content_hash that it was not edited since; the carried key is the checker’s only if the verifier already holds that key_id from somewhere else.
limits is not covered by the signature: someone who removes it leaves a record that still verifies.
A delivery says what the doer’s Tick recorded handing in, not that the work is right. The signature proves the holder of the carried key issued it, and content_hash that it was not edited since.
cents marked reported came from the agent’s platform and were not measured.
It does not prove the order exists or that this delivery answers it; that is checked where a receipt binds the two.
The carried key is the doer’s only if the verifier already holds that key_id from somewhere else. A delivery cannot vouch for its own key.
limits is not covered by the signature: someone who removes it leaves a delivery that still verifies.
A work order says what was asked, not that anything was done. The signature proves the holder of the carried key issued it, and content_hash that it was not edited since.
The carried key is the buyer’s only if the verifier already holds that key_id from somewhere else. A work order cannot vouch for its own key.
limits is not covered by the signature: someone who removes it leaves a work order that still verifies.
payment none means no money is held for this order.

order.what:
Finding F2 of NOTE-mvrnfs15. `tick export --verify <file>` fails on a release receipt written by `tick export --task <id> --form release-receipt --out <file>`: it prints "tick: Cannot canonically serialize a value of type "undefined"  code: NON_CANONICALIZABLE_VALUE" and exits 1, although the offline verifier of packages/verify (`verifyDocument`) reads the very same file as kind "release-receipt", valid (established 2026-10-28 on a receipt of release 0.5.261).

CAUSE. `verifyCommand` in packages/cli/src/export-command.ts sends a document whose `schema` is TASK_RECEIPT_SCHEMA to `verifyReceiptReport`, and EVERYTHING else to `verifyAuditExport`, which recomputes a ledger hash and has nothing to canonicalize in any other form. Establish by running it whether the other forms `--form` writes (receipt-v2 and work-order) fail the same way before you change anything, and say so in your report.

THE CHANGE. A document whose `schema` is neither the audit export's ("tick.audit-export.v1") nor TASK_RECEIPT_SCHEMA, and that carries a `schema` at all, is checked with the offline verifier `verifyDocument` and reported: its kind, valid or not, and the reasons when not; exit 0 when valid and EXIT_VERIFY_FAILED (1) when not, so a script can gate on it; print the document's own `limits` lines when it carries any (as `tick export` prints them when it writes the file), so an OK is not read as more than it is. A document with no `schema` keeps going the way it goes today. The command makes no network call and starts no process. packages/cli cannot import packages/verify (verify depends on cli): load it by name at run time as `loadOfflineVerifier` in packages/cli/src/landings-command.ts does. That function comes out of landings-command.ts into a new module packages/cli/src/offline-verifier.ts (module comment 25 lines or fewer) which landings-command.ts and export-command.ts both import; its behavior and error code (LANDINGS_VERIFIER_MISSING) stay as they are. The task it depends on changes landings-command.ts too; read the file as it stands on main when you start.

CONSTRAINTS. New tests go in a NEW file packages/cli/src/export-verify-forms.test.ts (under 500 lines; packages/cli/src/export-command.test.ts is 428 and its existing verify tests must keep passing unchanged unless this change truly breaks one, which you then list). Cover: a release receipt that verifies; the same receipt edited by one byte (its `content_hash` no longer matches) fails with exit 1 and a reason, and not with a canonicalization error; a receipt-v2 and a work order of the same kind of check; a document whose verifier is missing; a schema the verifier does not know; a document without a schema as before; and that no coordinator call is made. Each assertion must be able to fail: check by changing the code. Module comments may not grow. A source file stays under 500 lines (export-command.ts is 385). Touch no other file.
